cohort: The study included 365 pregnant women in their first trimester (11-14 weeks of gestation) from Siirt University Faculty of Medicine, enrolled between March 2022 and March 2023.
finding: No significant association was found between first-trimester placental volume/thickness and adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: No significant differences were found in placental volume measurements based on delivery mode.
birth_weight: Fetal weight was an outcome measured in the study.
gest_age: Babies included were 11-14 weeks of gestation at initial measurement, and gestational age at delivery was an outcome.
